provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Grand Austria Hotel rules (Lookout / Mayfair, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Game board and action board side by side; dustbin, VP markers, dishes and drinks nearby
Shuffle the Guest cards; 5 faceup on the Guest spaces

steps.note: First play: use the recommended sets

steps.text: One Politics card and one Emperor tile from each of A, B and C, faceup
{n} dice on the first Action space; Turn Order tiles for your player count
Each player: Overview card, Hotel board (all on the same side; first play: front) and 6 disks
Disks on Emperor track 0, Victory Point track 0 and Money track {n}
A coffee, wine, cake and strudel in your Kitchen; draw 6 Staff cards
Random start player takes Turn Order tile 1, the next 2, and so on
From the last player, counterclockwise: each takes a faceup guest into their Cafe for free (slide and refill)
Each player prepares up to 3 rooms, starting bottom left, paying the printed cost
The start player rolls all dice and sorts them onto the Action spaces
